issue.title: Aiden reports that after chatting with Donny on the macOS client and/or web, many of those messages never appear in the same conversation on the iOS app.
issue.summary: Aiden reports that after chatting with Donny on the macOS client and/or web, many of those messages never appear in the same conversation on the iOS app. The iOS client shows an incomplete conversation history, so the user cannot see messages that already exist on the other clients.
steps: Sign in to the same Teamily account on the macOS desktop client (or web) and on the iOS app.
Open the direct conversation with Donny and exchange a batch of messages from the Mac / web side (text plus any rich messages such as images, cards or quoted replies).
Open the same conversation on the iOS app and compare its message list against Mac / web.
Observed: a large number of the messages present on Mac / web are absent on iOS — the iOS conversation content is incomplete and out of sync.
issue.expected: Every client shows the same conversation content. Messages sent or received on Mac / web propagate to the iOS app in real time, or are reconciled by incremental fetch when the conversation is opened after a reconnect. No message should be missing on iOS, regardless of message type (text, image, card, quoted reply, agent card).
issue.actual: Many messages exchanged with Donny on the Mac / web client never show up on the iOS app: the iOS conversation is missing content and appears out of sync with the other clients.
issue.context:
- **Feature area**: Messaging / Multi-device message sync (IM)
- Not yet determined: whether the loss sits in the iOS sync chain (long connection / push / incremental pull after reconnect / seq gap) or whether specific message types (images, cards, quoted replies) are not synced.
- Not yet determined: whether this is related to multi-device read-state / seq alignment (maxSeq handling, unread seq) — the same account is signed in on Mac, web and iOS simultaneously.
- Not yet determined: whether Android is affected as well, or whether the problem is iOS-specific.
- Not yet determined: a stable reproduction path. To pin this down we need a fixed conversation plus a fixed set of messages (sender and timestamp range) that fail to appear on iOS.
- Related issues found during dedup: #1180 (closed) same problem class — multi-device message sync lag / occasional lost messages on desktop + web; #1541 (open) incomplete conversation list when the same account logs in on another client; #539 (closed) messages already read on other devices missing after login; #577 (closed) cross-platform read status not synced. None of them covers iOS as the client that is missing messages, so this is filed as a new issue and cross-referenced.
- Reporter: Aiden (cc: Cora). Reported 2026-09-21.
